name: Icon
description: Favicon and app-icon maker - a multi-size .ico, PNG and SVG, or the whole app kit as one zip.

inputs.label: Label
inputs.help: Up to ~4 characters reads best in a browser tab. The label auto-sizes to fill the icon.

inputs.label: Image
inputs.help: Optional logo or glyph shown above the label. Leave empty for a text-only icon.

inputs.label: Image zoom
inputs.help: Scale the image. 100% fills the icon width; go higher to crop in tighter, lower to add a margin.

inputs.label: Image X
inputs.help: Nudge the image left or right.

inputs.label: Image Y
inputs.help: Nudge the image up or down.

inputs.label: Weight
inputs.help: Heavier weights hold up better at tiny sizes. (SUSE Mono's heaviest face is Extra bold.)

inputs.label: Letter spacing
inputs.help: Negative values tuck the letters together - essential for fitting 3–4 monospace caps into a 16 px tile. Mono is wide, so push it well into the negatives.

inputs.label: Label size
inputs.help: Nudge the auto-fitted label size up or down (percent).

inputs.label: Show
inputs.help: Which face of the kit the canvas shows. The zip always holds every face, so this is a preview switch - and a way to export one on its own. The social card exports at 1200x630.

inputs.label: App name
inputs.help: Full name for the PWA manifest and the social card.

inputs.label: Short name
inputs.help: Home-screen label - kept short so a phone doesn't truncate it.

inputs.label: Maskable icon
inputs.help: Add an Android adaptive icon to the kit: the art sits inside the safe zone on a full-bleed tile, so the launcher can crop it to any shape.

inputs.label: Monochrome icon
inputs.help: Add a flat single-colour silhouette to the kit, for notification badges and pinned tabs. Only its alpha is used, so the platform recolours it.

inputs.label: 16 px preview
inputs.help: Show the icon at its real 16 and 32 px favicon sizes on the canvas so you can judge legibility. An editor aid only - never included in exports.
